g.text: Corridor Unit • Redrawn from the official plan & mirrored to this flat's orientation (stepped footprint)

Redrawn from the official HDB 3-Room Simplified (Corridor) plan, mirrored horizontally. The living room extends into a short passage leading to both bedrooms, so both bedrooms are L-shaped; the air well beside Bath/WC and the offset access balcony (deeper along Bedroom 2) complete the footprint.
